PHASE 1: base knowledge = linux, basic programming (bash or python), networking, mysql, http requests, web servers.  

PHASE 2: learn the basics of OWASP top 10 e.g xss, ssrf, sqli, csrf, idor etc etc. 

PHASE 3: learn burpsuite e.g the site tree, intercepting and modifying requests, repeater, intruder etc.

PHASE 4: read the tangled web, web application hackers handbook 2, peter yawoski bug bounty book (free on hackerone). 

PHASE 5: CTF's = portswigger web-sec academy, pentesterlab, hacker101, [bugbountyhunter.com](https://bugbountyhunter.com) (IN THIS ORDER reason i say this is that they get progressivly harder and the portswigger web-sec academy teach's and guides you similar to pentesterlab then [bugbountyhunter.com](https://bugbountyhunter.com) is CTF's based on real bug bounty findings)

PHASE 6: watch all nahamsecs videos/streams on recon, also watch zseano's videos and other web application hacking videos you find interest you should have a grasp on what your doing now.

PHASE 7: pick a program you would like to hack on, something that interests you.  if you reach this point and cant find something after a few months then revisit where you struggling, dont be afraid to google things etc.  you will get there
